scope: Standalone design prototype: scoped tool history, tab actions, themes, sidebar, account and shared components
checks: Account is top-right; language and theme belong to bottom sidebar
Authentication label opens active connection settings and preserves private draft
Tool history stays in workspace and filters exact tool and connection
Scoped detail deep links cannot access another tool or project run
Restoring scoped history creates an unexecuted independent draft
All seven screenshot menu actions, clipboard and keyboard focus work
Duplicating a non-active tab preserves its own invalid JSON but starts without result
Fixed tabs form a protected leading group; movement preserves active draft identity
Batch closing touches only current connection; same-URL personal connection stays isolated
A running tab is excluded from batch close and single close
Theme and collapse preserve unsaved form, DOM and draft identity
Dark theme applies to scoped history and Secret editor with visible actions
Both themes and locales keep primary controls and menu visible at four widths
Theme preference persists only an enum; invalid preference is discarded
